'''Pygorix''' was a [[Planet/Legends|world]] located in the [[Pygorix system/Legends|Pygorix system]]. It was situated in the [[Back Reach]] area of the [[Gordian Reach/Legends|Gordian Reach]] [[Sector/Legends|sector]] within the [[Trans-Hydian/Legends|Trans-Hydian]] portion of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. The [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] known as the [[Ardan Cross]] connected it to the [[Feldwes system/Legends|Feldwes system]] as well as the [[Spintir system/Legends|Spintir system]] of the [[Spadja sector/Legends|Spadja sector]]. A smaller [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] route linked Pygorix to the [[Karsten's World system/Legends|Karsten's World system]].<ref name="TEA" />

Pygorix served as a religious retreat known for [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]]-long study of the religious beliefs and experiences of various [[Species/Legends|species]]. Fees collected at an [[Orbit/Legends|orbital]] [[Space station/Legends|station]] that served as a customs [[Spaceport/Legends|port]] made Pygorix a wealthy world, and access to the nearby Karsten's World [[Star system/Legends|system]] was restricted to the [[high abbot]]s of Pygorix.<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
Pygorix was introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square Q-6.<ref name="TEA" />
